_comment: Golden regression corpus — every maintainer linguistic ruling, encoded.
Each entry: word → expected analyser behaviour. The test fails if a
future lexicon pass or engine change regresses any ruling.
verdict   — required. analyser verdict: valid | derived | unknown
root      — optional. phase2.root must equal this
2026-06-04  ai- is NOT a prefix (ai = free verb root)
2026-08-26  word-initial ia -> ïa corrected across the lexicon;
6 short-root rulings re-keyed to the new spelling and
the plain spellings kept as separate rulings.
